niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want a Jungian, meditation-based, or explicitly spiritual approach. These are good starting points based on the available course information:

### Shadow work
- **[Engage the Shadow — Jung Platform](https://jungplatform.com/course/engage-the-shadow)** — A strong choice for a broad Jungian introduction. It brings together ten depth-psychology teachers and covers personal and collective shadow, relationships, dreams, and practical exercises. About eight hours across ten classes.
- **[Embracing the Shadow — Awake Academy](https://www.awakeacademy.org/course/embracing-the-shadow/)** — A more explicitly integrative option, combining shadow work with mindfulness, Western psychology, insight practice, and Tibetan Buddhist perspectives. Self-paced, with 50 lessons and more than five hours of video; the listed price was £157.
- **[Shadow Work — Jungian Center for the Spiritual Sciences](https://jungian.directory/courses/shadow-work/)** — A shorter, independent-study workshop with audio lectures, readings, and exercises. The listed price was $75.

### Spiritual practice
- **[Mindworks mindfulness courses](https://mindworks.org/meditation-courses/mindfulness-courses/)** — A practical, progressive route into meditation, with guided practices and contemplation. Its introductory level is free, and the teaching draws on Buddhist wisdom without requiring a religious commitment.
- **[The Power of Awareness — Sounds True](https://www.soundstrue.com/collections/meditation)** — A seven-week mindfulness course with Jack Kornfield and Tara Brach, suited to building a regular practice.
- **[Mindfulness and Well-being: Peace In, Peace Out — Rice University Online](https://online.rice.edu/courses/mindfulness-and-well-being-peace-in-peace-out)** — A self-paced option that connects mindfulness with spiritual development and includes meditation and reflection exercises.
- **[WELCOME: Mindful Compassion Training — Naropa University](https://www.naropa.edu/academics/extended-campus/naropa-on-demand/welcome-on-demand/)** — An eight-module, self-paced course focused on compassion, with guided meditation, readings, and at-home practice.

**My quick picks:** Start with Mindworks for a low-commitment meditation foundation; choose Jung Platform for a multi-teacher Jungian overview; or try Awake Academy if you want shadow work explicitly blended with spiritual practice.

A note of care: shadow work can bring up painful memories or intense emotions. Go slowly, skip exercises that feel overwhelming, and consider working with a qualified mental-health professional if you have significant trauma or distress. These courses are educational, not a substitute for therapy. Prices and course details can change, so check the provider’s current page before enrolling.
